description: Capture fresh preview PNG assets from one or more live TOP nodes and write each target to its file_path. Use it to regenerate stale thumbnails after a network changes; pass targets as {node_path,file_path} plus optional width/height. Requires a running TouchDesigner bridge, overwrites image files, and returns written previews plus per-target warnings.

height.description: Preview height in pixels requested from the bridge capture helper.

targets.description: Preview capture jobs; each target maps one live TOP node to one local PNG file.

file_path.description: Local PNG file path to create or overwrite with the captured preview.

node_path.description: Live TOP node path to capture through the TouchDesigner bridge.

width.description: Preview width in pixels requested from the bridge capture helper.

name: refresh_asset_previews
title: Refresh asset previews
